limits.en: Open source, self-hosted, unlimited users and dashboards

keyLimits.en: Self-hosted only, unlimited users, dashboards and data sources
First 5 users included, then $6/month per extra user ($65/year); 3-day email/Slack support
First 10 users included, then $12/month per extra user; adds row/column permissions, SSO, caching, white-label
Starts around $20,000/year; dedicated success engineer, 1-day support SLA, air-gap deployment

addOns.en: Storage: from $2 per 1M rows (1M rows free)

cautions.en: The open-source edition is fully free but self-hosted only; the cloud Starter/Pro plans price by seat and usage add-ons stack on top.

capabilities.en: Visual query builder with joins, aggregations and 15+ built-in chart types
Native SQL editor with templates and snippets for advanced users
Interactive dashboards shareable by URL, plus scheduled email/Slack reports
Row, table and dashboard-level permissions, query logs and audit trails; SOC 2 Type II compliant

limitations.en: Web-based only, no desktop or mobile apps
Requires a database connection to be useful beyond CSV upload; the visual builder has limits for highly complex queries, where SQL is still needed

reason.en: Both build BI dashboards from company data; Looker Studio is Google's free option while Metabase can be self-hosted for full control.
Also open-source and self-hostable for dashboards, more oriented toward metrics/observability than business SQL analytics.
Competes for team data exploration and dashboards, with a stronger notebook/analytics-engineering angle.

unknowns: Mobile app availability not confirmed on official pages seen
